voice.style: Read like a calm, confident product-film narrator. Warm, natural, unhurried, with a little smile. Land the last word of each line.

lines.text: What if every frame of your launch video was code?
No timeline. No keyframes. No editor.
You write the story. The agent writes the motion.
Every move lands on a word, and every sound lands on a move.
Render it. Check it. Ship it.
Code motion. Video, written in code.
